title: Doctor Doom's Hell Reforms Force Black Panther and Namor Into an Uneasy Alliance
excerpt:
Doom's decision to void Mephisto's contracts unleashes chaos beyond Hell.
Black Panther and Namor confront a powerful new threat called the Kingkiller.
body_md:
In the Marvel miniseries Black Panther & Namor: Doomed, Victor von Doom's attempt to govern Hell differently from Mephisto produces consequences far beyond the underworld. After taking Mephisto's throne, Doom cancels the former ruler's contracts with humans and allows Hell's inhabitants to leave freely. His reforms quickly destabilize other realms.

Demons attack Atlantis and threaten Wakanda, prompting two longstanding rivals, Namor and Black Panther, to join forces. Their pursuit takes them into Hell, where they discover that Doom did not personally order the attacks. Instead, a mysterious figure called the Kingkiller is targeting monarchs across the universe. Star-Lord, now the crowned leader of the Galactic Union, is among the threatened rulers.

Doom describes the Kingkiller as a being of the same species as the Watchers, suggesting extraordinary power. The three rulers share an enemy but little trust. Doom ultimately acknowledges that he cannot defeat this threat alone and presses his reluctant allies to stand with him.

The storyline also questions the motives behind Doom's reforms. He wanted to demonstrate that he could rule more fairly than Mephisto, yet failed to consider what would happen when demons escaped into other worlds. Namor condemns his arrogance. Black Panther defends the principle of freeing Hell's inhabitants while insisting that Doom must eventually answer for the harm his actions caused.

By issue three, Namor is separated from his allies and encounters a figure who died defending Atlantis before reaching the Kingkiller. The chapter closes on a cliffhanger about the larger plan behind the deaths. These developments belong to Marvel's comics continuity and do not confirm any plot points for upcoming films.

seo_description: Marvel's Black Panther & Namor: Doomed pits rival rulers against the Kingkiller after Doom's changes to Hell unleash chaos.
